name: akta/companies
description: Build a list of companies matching industry, location and funding filters.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return (1-50, default 10). Each returned row is charged, so this caps the cost of one call.

filters.description: Filter conditions keyed by field, combined with AND. List values match any of the given values; ranges take {gte, lte}. Example: {"location.hq.country": ["USA"], "firmographic.founded_year": {"gte": 2015}, "funding_detail.funding_overview.funding_stage": ["series_a"]}. Get the supported keys from the filter list endpoint and allowed values from the filter options endpoint; industry.industry takes codes from Industry Search.

sort_by.description: Field to sort by. Default relevance.

pricing.note: Billed per call from metered usage; the reference price is typical.

readme:
# Akta Companies

Build a list of companies matching industry, location and funding filters.

## Pricing

- Inspect reference unit price: $0.01 USD per result.
- Inspect flat fee: $0.075 USD per call.
- Final settlement uses the provider-reported actual cost after strict validation; the reference price is not used to infer the final charge.
